source.page_or_item: Executive Order 8413—Exemption of Hubert K. Bishop From Compulsory Retirement for Age; May 18, 1940; APP node 368457; common-crawl capture 2025-10-14T05:21:19Z

clauses.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Hubert K. Bishop, Chief, Division of Construction, Public Roads Administration, Federal Works Agency, who, during the month of June, 1940, will reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic separation from the service, applicable to him, be exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, see. 715a), I hereby exempt the said Hubert K. Bishop from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending June 30, 1041.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

source.page_or_item: Executive Order 8810—Exemption of Hubert K. Bishop From Compulsory Retirement for Age; June 30, 1941; APP node 210617; common-crawl capture 2025-10-14T22:21:35Z

ACTOR_TEXT:EO:8810.text:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Hubert K. Bishop, Chief, Division of Construction, Public Roads Administration, Federal Works Agency, who was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year by Executive Order No. 8413 of May 18, 1940, be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Hubert K. Bishop from compulsory retirement for age fot a period of one year ending June 30, 1942.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

June 30, 1941.
